columns.family: score2 | progressive | sensitivity_independent | sensitivity_diabetes_hba1c | latent | continuous | physician_thresholds.
columns.replicate: Replicate index (Monte Carlo replications of a family).
columns.latent_gamma: Scenario E1: influence of the unobserved determinant U (NaN elsewhere).
columns.threshold_log_sd: Scenario E2: SD of log k_j, the physician-specific threshold multiplier (NaN elsewhere).
columns.window_size: Progressive rules: number of covariates in the rule; 0 for SCORE2.
columns.window_start: Progressive rules: position of the window in the covariate list.
columns.n_binary_rule_variables: Number of binary covariates in the rule.
columns.threshold_strategy: Threshold calibration strategy of progressive rules.
columns.realised_eligibility: Realised eligible fraction in the cohort.
columns.max_attainable_eligibility: Largest eligibility reachable by the window (target_joint).
columns.calibration_attainable: Whether the target eligibility was reached within 0.01.
columns.n_patients_cohort: Number of patients in the cohort.
columns.n_physicians: Number of physicians in the cohort.
columns.physician_group: Five-group design: group 1 to 5; empty for continuous heterogeneity.
columns.threshold_multiplier: Scenario E2: multiplier k_j of the physician's SCORE2 thresholds (1 elsewhere).
columns.n_eligible: Truly eligible patients of the physician.
columns.D_star_intrinsic: Intrinsic inconsistency (scenario E1: patients sharing the unobserved U); equals D_star elsewhere.
columns.D_tilde: Empirical discordance over all pairs of eligible patients (manual pairing).
columns.D_star_ineligible: Theoretical discordance among ineligible patients 2 p_low (1 - p_low).
columns.D_tilde_ineligible: Empirical discordance over all pairs of ineligible patients.
columns.supervised: Whether the estimator uses the outcome when learning.
columns.computed_as: Design actually computed (identical by construction for unsupervised methods).
columns.caliper_percentile: Caliper percentile used for pairing (100 = no caliper; NaN for the GLMM).
columns.score: Estimated discordance rate, or GLMM mean squared Pearson residual.
columns.n_candidates: Patients in the physician's candidate pool for this design.
columns.n_patients_paired: Patients appearing in at least one retained pair.
columns.caliper_threshold: Caliper distance (mean over cells when pairing is within folds).
columns.frac_pairs_both_eligible: Share of pairs with both patients truly eligible.
columns.frac_pairs_mixed: Share of pairs with exactly one truly eligible patient.
columns.frac_pairs_both_ineligible: Share of pairs with no truly eligible patient.
columns.disc_pairs_both_eligible: Discordance among pairs with both patients eligible.
columns.disc_pairs_both_ineligible: Discordance among pairs with both patients ineligible.
columns.smd_within_max: Max over covariates of the mean absolute within-pair difference, in cohort SD units.
columns.smd_within_mean: Mean over covariates of the same quantity.
columns.fit_seconds: Wall-clock time of fitting for this design (0 when the full-data fit is reused).
columns.estimate_seconds: Wall-clock time of distance computation, pairing and scoring for this design.
columns.n_fits: Number of fits performed for this design.
columns.fit_reused: Whether the full-data fit of in_sample was reused.
columns.launch_id: UTC timestamp of the launch that computed the experiment (YYYYmmddTHHMMSSZ).
columns.code_fingerprint: SHA-256 (12 hex) of src/**/*.py and of the resolved configuration.
